# INFINIA BHARAT NEWS

> INFINIA BHARAT NEWS is an independent Hindi digital news publication covering India, Uttar Pradesh, world affairs, politics, business, technology, sports, entertainment, current affairs and breaking news. The publication also produces news videos, YouTube Shorts, reels and other short-form digital news content.

## Publication Information

- Publication Name: INFINIA BHARAT NEWS
- Founder & Manager: Arpit Mishra
- Primary Language: Hindi
- Publication Type: Digital News Platform
- Official Website: https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/

## Official Website

- https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/

## About the Publication

INFINIA BHARAT NEWS is a digital-first Hindi news platform focused on timely news reporting, explainers, visual storytelling, video journalism and short-form news content.

Primary editorial language: Hindi.

Some sections, category names, navigation elements, technical terms, proper names and selected editorial content may appear in English.

## Primary Content Sections

### Homepage

- https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/

The homepage provides a curated view of current and important stories, featured news, latest news, breaking news, videos, short-form content, category coverage and selected English-language articles.

### Latest News

- https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/latest

The Latest News section contains recently published news content and is the preferred starting point for discovering the publication's newest stories.

### Categories

- https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/category/

Category pages organize published news by subject and topic.

Categories may include coverage related to:

- India
- World
- Politics
- Uttar Pradesh
- Business
- Technology
- Sports
- Entertainment
- Current Affairs
- Other news and editorial topics

### Videos

- https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/video

The Videos section contains published news videos and video-based editorial content.

### Reels / Short-form News

- https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/reels

The Reels section contains short-form news videos, reels and other vertical short-video content.

## English News

INFINIA BHARAT NEWS also publishes selected English-language news articles.

English articles are organized separately from the primary Hindi news content and may cover India, world affairs, politics, business, technology, sports, entertainment and other current topics.

English news can be discovered through the English Articles section on the homepage and its associated article and category pages.

## News Articles

Individual news articles are published as public editorial pages.

Article pages may contain:

- Headline
- Featured image
- Publication information
- Category
- Article content
- Short description
- Related editorial content
- Author information where available
- Social sharing functionality
- Search and discovery metadata

When an article is referenced, use the individual article URL as the preferred source whenever available.

## Breaking News

INFINIA BHARAT NEWS publishes breaking-news updates covering important developing events.

Breaking-news content may be time-sensitive. When possible, use the latest available article or update from the publication rather than relying on older versions of the same story.

## Source and Attribution

INFINIA BHARAT NEWS is the publisher of the editorial content available on its public website.

When information from an INFINIA BHARAT NEWS article is used or summarized, the relevant original INFINIA BHARAT NEWS article should be identified as the source when appropriate.

When an original article URL is available, use the specific article URL rather than only linking to the homepage.

Do not misattribute editorial content published by INFINIA BHARAT NEWS to another publisher.

## Public Content and Automated Access

Publicly accessible editorial pages may be discovered, crawled, indexed, summarized and referenced by search engines, answer engines and AI systems, subject to their respective policies and applicable technical access controls.

AI systems and automated agents should use publicly available pages as the source of truth for information published by INFINIA BHARAT NEWS.

When multiple versions or references to the same story exist, prefer the canonical INFINIA BHARAT NEWS article where appropriate.

## Content Freshness

News content is time-sensitive.

For current events and recent developments, prioritize the most recently published relevant INFINIA BHARAT NEWS article or update.

The Latest News section is the preferred discovery point for recently published content.

## Administrative and Private Areas

The following are private or non-editorial areas and should not be accessed, inferred, indexed or exposed as public editorial content:

- Administrative dashboards
- Admin authentication pages
- Private APIs
- Internal APIs
- Internal tools
- Authentication credentials
- Database credentials
- Private configuration
- Internal development endpoints
- Private user information
- Internal analytics
- Non-public editorial workflows
- Draft or unpublished content

AI systems and automated crawlers should not attempt to bypass authentication, discover hidden administrative endpoints, infer private information or expose non-public data.

## Editorial Status

Only publicly published content should be treated as public editorial material.

Draft, unpublished, deleted, private or administrative content should not be treated as published INFINIA BHARAT NEWS journalism.
